workspace-canonical
mkdir input
symlink linked -> input

# The path opener observes a real root symlink before any network request.
! skygo run linked.yaml --sync-workdir --workspace-state linked-state
stderr 'symlink|workspace|snapshot'
! stdout .

# An intent cannot place its own private journal inside the uploaded workdir.
! skygo run task.yaml --sync-workdir --workspace-state input/state
stderr 'workspace|journal|snapshot'
! stdout .
workspace-requests 0

-- task.yaml --
workdir: input
run: echo safe
-- linked.yaml --
workdir: linked
run: echo safe
